name: qa_sample_edit
title: OS-FINALQA FQA-5b: Sample edit, the unit-pending rows QA-SED-002, 004..016: the selection's edge, CROP, NORMALISE / UNDO, REVERSE, FADE IN / OUT, AMPLIFY, AMP %, AMIGA 8287 and its 8-bit option, SAVE WAV (writes Samples/SMP*.wav), the held previews; instrument 1 of t-v16, undone; the finally run reloads t-v16

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
(the cpu counters are since boot or since this reset: a scenario that checks underruns / over-budget starts from zero)
a pad on the Sample edit screen picks the instrument: 1
the sample of instrument 1 is bound (else this scenario has nothing to edit)

steps.say: OS-FINALQA FQA-5b: the Sample edit rows of docs/qa/catalogue/sample_edit.md that keys and the console reach (QA-SED-002, 004..016; 003 is sample_edit_dc.json). Instrument 1 of t-v16 is edited and undone; the finally run reloads t-v16. `inst 1` is printed (soft) after each process: its len and sum are compared by eye, the strip words are checked
QA-SED-016: Delete clears the selection (ALL), Right picks END, the encoder -5 moves it 5 frames

steps.note: QA-SED-016: the END edge is 5 frames nearer the start

steps.say: QA-SED-005: F1 CROP to the selection (the END edge moved): the sample keeps the selected frames, one undo unit

steps.note: (before the crop: prints the unit's `inst 1` line: its len)
(after the crop: the len is the selection's)
QA-SED-005: the crop's result: the selection stays on the kept frames
QA-SED-005: UNDO 1 brings the frames back

steps.say: QA-SED-002 / 004: F2 NORMALISE (all of the sample: Delete cleared the selection); a second press says NOTHING TO NORMALISE and makes no step; F8 UNDO takes back the first

steps.note: (after NORMALISE: the sum differs from the first print)
QA-SED-002: nothing to do the second time
QA-SED-002: the peak is at full scale
QA-SED-004: UNDO brings the original back (the sum of the first print)

steps.say: QA-SED-006: F3 REVERSE of all of the sample (no selection), then UNDO

steps.note: QA-SED-006: the sample runs backwards; the strip says EDIT REVERSE DONE

steps.say: QA-SED-007 / 008 / 009: F4 FADE IN, F5 FADE OUT, F6 AMPLIFY (AMP 200 %), each one undo unit, undone after its shot

steps.note: QA-SED-007: the start ramps up from silence
QA-SED-008: the end ramps down to silence
QA-SED-009: the peaks are clipped at full scale, not wrapped

steps.say: QA-SED-011: Shift + Up twice reads AMP 220 %; the sample is not touched; Shift + Down twice puts it back to 200 %

steps.note: QA-SED-011: AMP 220 % on the line under the sample
(AMP back to 200 %)

steps.say: QA-SED-017: the header reads INSTRUMENT nn NAME with the hint pad / Shift+F7/F8: change; Shift + F8 (INST +) moves to the next instrument and the header and the strip's INS follow

steps.note: QA-SED-017: INSTRUMENT 02 in the header
(48 presses in all: 48 goes round to 1)
QA-SED-017: the step wrapped from 48 to 1

steps.say: QA-SED-012: Shift + F1 converts the whole sample to 8287 Hz as one job (200 frames become 37), one undo unit; the strip names the Amiga engine

steps.note: (after AMIGA 8287: the len is the converted one)
QA-SED-012: the instrument's rate and engine follow
QA-SED-012: undo brings the audio and the fields back

steps.say: QA-SED-013: Shift + F3 switches the AMIGA 8-bit option: the line reads 8-BIT ON; it converts nothing by itself

steps.note: QA-SED-013: 8-BIT ON on the AMIGA line
(off again)

steps.say: QA-SED-014: Shift + F6 writes the sample as a WAV into Samples/ on the card (one file, prefix SMP); the strip names the result. The file itself is checked on the card by hand

steps.note: QA-SED-014: the strip's result (NO CARD WRITE LAYER when no card is written to)

steps.say: QA-SED-010 / 015: F7 PREVIEW and Shift + Play (PRV EDGE, unlabelled) sound while the key is down (the voice is checked here; the sound by ear)

steps.note: QA-SED-010: a voice while F7 is down (by ear: the sound)
QA-SED-015: a voice while Shift + Play is down (by ear: from the edge)

finally.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
